purpose: Teach: やれる/切符/通す/光る/盛り上がる/不公平/仕上がり/固い

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、自分で、絶対、やれる、絶対、わよ
lines.en: Sho, you can absolutely do this yourself — I mean it.
lines.style: Warm, steady conviction. Leans slightly forward. Speaks with the patient firmness of a mother who believes in her child before the child believes in himself. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、新幹線の、絶対、切符、絶対、買ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad really did buy the shinkansen tickets — he actually did it!
lines.style: Bright surprise bubbling just under the surface. Quick intake of breath on the realization. Words tumble slightly, eager to share the news. Still processing his own wonder.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、お電話、絶対、通す、絶対、ね
lines.en: Sho, call your father and tell him thank you — go on.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Not a suggestion but not harsh either. A gentle push toward doing the right thing. Brief and clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お星様が、本気で、絶対、光る、絶対、よね
lines.en: Mom, the stars are going to shine bright, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy question. Gaze lifted slightly upward. Wondering aloud rather than asking for confirmation. Small voice, big thoughts.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達と、本気で、絶対、盛り上がる、絶対、お話、絶対、できた?本気で
lines.en: Sho, did you have a good time with your friends? Tell me you did.
lines.style: Warm curiosity, searching his face. Gentle probe — she cares whether he had fun, not just that he behaved. Slight lift at the end, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お兄ちゃんだけ、本気で、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、長くやれて、絶対、不公平、絶対、だよ
lines.en: Mom, it's not fair — only big brother gets to play games longer than me!
lines.style: Plaintive whine with the thin edge of real frustration underneath. Head tips slightly, voice stretches on 'unfair.' The complaint of a six-year-old who genuinely feels unseen.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの、本気で、絶対、ケーキ、絶対、仕上がり、絶対、見て
lines.en: Sho, look — look at what Mom made. The cake turned out beautiful.
lines.style: Quiet pride in her work. Slight catch of anticipation — she wants him to see it the way she does. Genuinely pleased, not performing. Inviting his wonder.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、お肩、絶対、固い、絶対、ね
lines.en: Mom, Dad's shoulders are really stiff, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle, close observation. Speaks as though noticing something delicate. Not quite a question, more a private thought said aloud. The perceptiveness of a child who watches.
